answer: What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The glacier is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the walnut. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
